ud1.7:1.1: evam me sutaṃ. ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Pāṭaliyaṃ viharati Ajakalāpake cetiye Ajakalāpakassa yakkhassa bhavane. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ abbhokāse nisinno hoti, devo ca ekamekaṃ phusāyati. atha kho Ajakalāpako yakkho bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukamo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato avidūre tikkhattuṃ akkulopakkulo ti akkulapakkulikaṃ akāsi: eso te samaṇa pisāco 'ti.
ud1.7:2.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud1.7:3.1: yadā sakesu dhammesu pāragū hoti brāhmano, atha etam pisācañ ca bakkulañ c' ātivattatī 'ti.||7||
